136
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 23, 2005/Pausa 2, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Health and Family
Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Over-bridges/under-bridges under
construction in Assam
*441. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of over-bridges/under-
bridges under construction in Assam;
(b) the details of the proposals sent by
the Government of Assam for construction
of over-bridges/under-bridges at railway
crossings; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Locomotive manufacturing units
*442. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of locomotive
manufacturing units and their production
capacity;
(b) whether there are other production
units outside the PSUs and if so, the details
thereof;
(c) whether his Ministry utilizes the full
capacity of the production units;
(d) whether the production in
Chittaranjan Locomotive Works has
decreased during  the last five years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Damage to crops due to pests and
other diseases
*443. SHRI ANAND SHARMA : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the large scale damage caused
to various crops in major States due to
pests and other diseases;
(b) if so, the steps taken to eradicate
the same to protect the crops; and
(c) the coverage of various crops in the
country under crop insurance scheme?
Forest development area projects of
A. P.
*444. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH : Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Forest

137
Development Area (FDA) projects of
Andhra Pradesh pending with the Union
Government;
(b) whether Government have drawn
up any plan on these project proposals;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of the fund released by
his Ministry for FDA projects in Andhra
Pradesh during the last one and a half year?
Facilities with CWC to store gold
*445. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Warehousing Corporation (CWC) is setting
up facilities to store gold at its warehouses
across the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
CWC will set up vaults at their godowns
where the farmers can deposit their gold;
and
(c) if so, the reasons for this sudden
interest?
Gauge conversion of Madurai-
Dindigul rail line
*446. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for the nine
on-going gauge conversion projects in the
southern zone Rs. 500.00 crores were
needed but the amount sanctioned was only
Rs. 125.00 crores;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Madurai-
Dindigul metre-gauge line has to be
converted in view of increase in traffic; and
(d) if so, the steps taken in this regard?
Construction of godowns
*447. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN :
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of godowns and their
storage capacity under the control of Food
Corporation of India (FCI) and Central
Warehousing Corporation in the country,
State-wise;
(b) whether Government propose to
construct more godowns in the country
during the Tenth Five Year Plan; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Licences for sugar mills
†*448.  SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the recent
years, Government have removed the
necessity of taking licences for sugar mills;
(b) if so, when this decision was taken;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this was
the first step in the direction of making
sugar industry free from Government
control; and
(d) if so, the facts thereof and the
decision taken/likely to be taken to make
sugar industry free from Government
Control?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Study leave to doctors
*449. PROF.P. J. KURIAN : Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Fifth Central Pay
Commission had recommended three years
study leave to doctors for attending P.G.
courses which cover three years of duration;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
Iron ore reserves
*450. SHRI DEVDAS APTE: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the mine-
able reserve of iron ore in the country is
much less than many other iron ore
producing countries; and
(b) whether it is also a fact that our

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS

(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing
Industries; Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Help to drought-hit regions
3352. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to bail out drought-hit Rajasthan
and other similarly placed regions;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the position of Orissa where some
of the districts are facing drought like
situation indicating the action plan of
Government to help out this poverty
stricken State as well?
Advisory to Andhra Pradesh for
cropping pattern
3353. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have sent an
Advisory to Andhra Pradesh Government
to change the cropping pattern;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reaction of the State Government
to this suggestion;
(d) whether more emphasis will be given
to diversification of crops; and
(e) the details of extent of funding that
will be given to the State to implement this
Advisory?
Crop diversification project of
Maharashtra
3354. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Maharashtra has submitted a crop
diversification project, in view of
droughts and crop failures, year after
year for 3-4 consecutive years, and the
distress sales and suicides resorted to
by farmers;
(b) if so, the salient features of the crop
diversification plan; and
(c) the Central Government's decision
thereon?

670
Irrigated area under drip and
sprinkler system
3355. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the approximate total irrigated area
under drip and sprinkler system and the
steps being taken to increase it;
(b) the benefits of this system; and
(c) the States where this modern
irrigation is more popular and the details of
work being done to take it to other States?
Drought in States
3356. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the drought
situation prevailing in Maharashtra,
Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh,
Rajasthan, consecutively for the past 3-4
years, the State Governments have
requested for the Central Assistance for
relief measures and for mitigating the
hardships of the farmers;
(b) if so, the demands, so made, during
the last three years and the extent to which
the same was met from the Calamity Relief
Funds and the National Contingency Fund,
State-wise; and
(c) how it was related to the loss/damage
to crops suffered in each State?
Popularising latest techniques
†3357. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have made different provisions through
different mediums to make the farmers of
the country aware about the latest
techniques of farming;
(b) if so, the details of these mediums
and provisions;
(c) whether it is also a fact that inspite
of the above efforts, 60 per cent farmers of
the country are unaware about the latest
techniques; and
(d) if so, the facts thereof and whether
Government have decided to make current
measures more effective?
Standing Committee on Agriculture
3358. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have formed a
separate Standing Committee on Agriculture
for improving conditions of this sector;
(b) if so, whether this Committee would
look into the root cause of farmers suicides
and strive to alleviate poverty by providing
them with better infrastructure;
(c) whether any suggestion has been
made that Centre should invest in rural
sector and make massive efforts to attract
and retain youth in villages;
(d) within what time this Committee had
submitted its report to Government; and
(e) the steps being taken to implement
them?
Assistance to a dairy run by ladies in
Rajasthan
†3359. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is only

(c) if so, the details of the funds given
and its utilization; and
(d) the details of the progress made so
